description: C6 / P41: workflow_call ENTRE REPOS. A repository other than ai-native (template-starter, the v2 Starter that M5.4 will migrate) calls ai-native's reusable l3-consumer.yml pinned by full SHA. The call fetches the platform release asset, checks its sha256 against the lock, verifies the sigstore attestation (--require-attestation, fail closed) and runs the L3 gate. Real run on GitHub Actions, not simulated; the PR that triggered it was throwaway and closed unmerged. runtime/pilot/c6.test.mjs re-reads this run from the GitHub API.
requiredSuccessfulSteps: Read the locks and pick the trust root (base lock first, then the head lock)
Select the trusted platform commit (must be in the history of the default branch)
Bootstrap sync (download, sha256 vs lock, sigstore attestation)

visibility.note: D1 resolved: ai-native is PUBLIC for now, so a public consumer can call it

limits: evidence run: `platform-ref` pointed the gate code at ai-native main because the pinned release (alpha.1) predates the L3 module; the workflow reports this as a warning. The release path without platform-ref is exercised by the rc.1 canary (M5.4).

first attempt (run 37139689695) reached the L3 gate and FAILED on integrity: detached HEAD compared the recorded branch with null. Fixed in ai-native PR #44 and re-run green; kept here because it is the reason the fix exists.
